messages:
renee (product): Quick follow-up from the all-hands pricing segment. Posting a tidy thread for any leftover questions on prepaid credits, burst, and enforcement. Keep Qs short.
leo (ops): Can prepaid credits be used to cover burst add-on usage automatically, or do customers need to opt in?
sam (finance): Prepaid credits are consumed before post-paid charges. For burst add-ons we honor prepaid balances if the add-on is configured to bill against the org pool. Sales can toggle this for enterprise deals.
tara (support): If a customer enables a burst and then exhausts both prepaid credits and monthly quota mid-job, what's the exact response code for running jobs? 402/429/200+footer?
mike (eng): For best-effort completion we allow in-flight requests to finish if they are within a safe token budget. Otherwise we terminate with 402 (Payment Required). For transient throttles we use 429 + Retry-After. SDKs should handle both.
leo (ops): Is there an automated notification before a burst starts charging if it will exceed prepaid funds? Customers asked for a warning.
sam (finance): Yes  we surface a console modal and send an email if an impending burst will consume >90% of prepaid balance. There's also a webhook org admins can register.
renee (product): What about "freeze" policies? Some customers want to stop usage automatically once credits hit 0 rather than allow fallback. Can they configure that?
leo (ops): Yes. Org admins can set `on_zero: block` or `on_zero: fallback` in the quota policy. `block` hard-blocks new requests; `fallback` routes to a cheaper compatible model if available.
tara (support): For private deployments with metering back to Redwood, do prepaid credits ever apply? Several POCs asked.
sam (finance): Only when the private deployment reports metering to our control plane and the contract states credit usage. Pure self-hosted without metering = no hosted credits.
mike (eng): Small SDK note: we added `X-Balance-Remaining` and `X-Burst-Allowed` headers to help clients show accurate UI. `X-Balance-Remaining` is in cents equivalent and can be polled.
tara (support): Refund policy quick recap? If a customer accidentally leaves a stress test running, what's the likely outcome?
sam (finance): Case-by-case. Small one-off mistakes typically get goodwill credits; >$10k requires review. We prefer issuing invoice credits unless refund to card is necessary.
billing-bot: Billing alert: "Org: blue-ocean, prepaid_balance 12% remaining - email sent"
renee (product): Thanks everyone. If you still need a written RFC or a short FAQ entry, react with :eyes: and I'll draft and share the link.
